title: Christmas 2025 BBC Radio Live at Coventry Cathedral
subtitle: A Historic National Broadcast of Tamil & English Praise
quote: Proclaiming the Prince of Peace under the soaring arches of Coventry Cathedral.
featuredCaption: Coventry Cathedral sanctuary filled with praise during the BBC Live broadcast
narrative: Cornerstone Tamil Church Coventry achieved a historic milestone by participating in the live BBC Radio Christmas broadcast at the world-renowned Coventry Cathedral. Believers gathered beneath the cathedral's iconic tapestry and soaring architecture to sing traditional carols and Tamil hymns, sharing the message of Christ's nativity with tens of thousands of listeners across the United Kingdom.

title: 2024 Christmas Carol with Croydon London Fellowship
subtitle: United Choir Cantatas & Festive Fellowship
quote: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
featuredCaption: Joint congregation family photo celebrating Christmas 2024 with Croydon London believers
narrative: On Sunday, 22nd December 2024, our annual Christmas Carol celebration brought together families from Coventry, Warwickshire, and our visiting brothers and sisters from Croydon, London. The evening featured uplifting choir cantatas, traditional Tamil carols, youth choreography, Scripture recitations, and a generous communal fellowship feast.

title: Palm Sunday, Good Friday & Easter Resurrection Celebration
subtitle: From Gethsemane's Cross to the Empty Tomb
quote: He is not here; for He is risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
featuredCaption: Church family gathered on stage celebrating Christ's triumphant resurrection
narrative: Remembering the supreme sacrifice and celebrating the glorious resurrection of our Lord Jesus Christ across Holy Week. From the joyous Hosanna palm processions to solemn Good Friday Holy Communion and triumphant Resurrection Sunday praise, our church family worshipped our living Savior.

title: Mother's Day Celebrations & Women of God
subtitle: Honouring the Godly Women Who Anchor Our Families
quote: Her children rise up and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.
featuredCaption: Mothers choir presenting special anthems during the Mother's Day service
narrative: Every year in March, Cornerstone Tamil Church honours, prays for, and celebrates the self-sacrificing mothers and women of our congregation. Featuring special choral presentations by our mothers, Scripture readings from Proverbs 31, and pastoral blessings with floral gifts from Pastor Clint Pratheepan.

title: Christmas Charity & Mission Outreach to India
subtitle: Extending Christ's Love to Rural Orphanages & Villages
quote: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did for me.
featuredCaption: Presentation of church mission offerings supporting care homes and rural outreach in India
narrative: True Christian love extends far beyond four walls. During our 2023 Christmas Carol celebration, Cornerstone Church members raised sacrificial financial offerings to support underprivileged children, orphanages, and rural pioneer ministries in India, providing essential educational kits, warm clothes, and food provisions.

title: Christmas 2022 & New Year Watchnight Service
subtitle: Entering the New Year on Our Knees in Thanksgiving
quote: The Lord has done great things for us, and we are glad.
featuredCaption: Welcoming the new year on our knees in thanksgiving and dedicatory prayer
narrative: A festive season marked by rich carol presentations in Tamil and English, joyful family gatherings, and our traditional New Year Watchnight service where believers stepped into 2023 on their knees in thanksgiving, receiving Scripture promises and praying for God's blessing across our families.
